dockerfile:
# loong64 self-built (wave25) - WD=/app/config 对齐商店包挂载约定（wave20 修复沿用）
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata)
WORKDIR /app/config
COPY glance /app/glance
RUN chmod +x /app/glance
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/glance"]

files.config.yaml:
storage: /verdaccio/storage/data
auth:
  htpasswd:
    file: /verdaccio/storage/htpasswd
    max_users: -1
uplinks:
  npmjs:
    url: https://registry.npmmirror.com
packages:
  '@*/*':
    access: $all
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
  '**':
    access: $all
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
middlewares:
  audit:
    enabled: true
log: { type: stdout, format: pretty, level: http }
web: { title: Verdaccio }
publish: true

dockerfile:
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive npm_config_registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com TZ=Asia/Shanghai
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN npm install -g verdaccio@7.1.0
RUN mkdir -p /verdaccio/storage && chmod -R 777 /verdaccio
COPY config.yaml /verdaccio/config.yaml
VOLUME /verdaccio/storage
EXPOSE 4873
ENTRYPOINT ["verdaccio","--config","/verdaccio/config.yaml","--listen","0.0.0.0:4873"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2 libapache2-mod-php ca-certificates php8.4-gd php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-curl php8.4-zip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cron >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
COPY site /var/www/html/
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["sh","-c",". /etc/apache2/envvars && exec apache2 -D FOREGROUND"]
